body.name: Pair-orbit observation kernel
body.construction: For every \(h\in\mathcal H_{J,s}\), \(n\in\mathcal N_J\), and \(o\in\mathcal O_J\), set \(K_{hno}=C_n^{-1}[x_{00}^{n_{00}}x_{11}^{n_{11}}x_{\mathrm m}^{n_{\mathrm m}}z^o]F_h(x,z)\). Thus incompatible joint margins have coefficient zero and \(\sum_{o\in\mathcal O_J}K_{hno}=1\).
